summary: Tested all 14 features for dual-tone theme on Mango and Nutricare pages, plus regression checks for Pharmacy. All core features PASS. Mango page has dark top (#050510), 100px gradient transition, cream light zone (#FFF8F0), and header transitions to light mode. Nutricare page has dark top (#050510), 80px gradient transition, cream light zone (#FFF8F0), light-themed category pills (#f5f0eb), and header transitions to light mode. Pharmacy dual-tone and header transition still work (regression pass). Mango category pages still work.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dual-tone theme verified working on all three pages (Pharmacy, Mango, Nutricare). All use IntersectionObserver to detect light zone and pass lightMode to ServiceHeader. ServiceHeader transitions from dark (#0a0b14) to cream (#FFF8F0) with 0.5s CSS transition. Logo gets darkened (brightness 0.15), wallet icon changes to amber-600, user icon changes to dark, tab gradients fade to cream. Mango transition is 100px, Nutricare is 80px. Nutricare pills use #f5f0eb for inactive state.
